tips.text: Throw Darkin Daggers at the enemy champion, then recast it once they are bleeding. The recast hurts more the lower their health is, and it heals you.
Use Darkin Daggers on the wave too. Its bleed finishes off low-health minions, which helps you last-hit.
Hit champions with your abilities as often as you can. Each hit shortens the wait for the next Packmate in We Are More.
Use Eviscerate to dash in, hit with both parts, and dash out. It also heals your Packmates to full.
Press The Call of the Pack to dodge an incoming spell, since you can't be targeted at the start. Then fight while you have extra damage and speed.
At level 6, use Hounds' Pursuit to jump onto a champion who is low on health. If you get the takedown, recast it for a shield and a second target.
Hounds' Pursuit has a short wind-up before the dash. Stuns and knockups can interrupt it, so don't start it when the enemy can interrupt you.
Hit a champion with Darkin Daggers, then recast it while they are still bleeding. The recast deals more damage the lower their health is, and it heals you.
Use Darkin Daggers to finish off camp monsters. The bleed finishes small monsters that are low on health.
Land your abilities on champions or large monsters often. Each hit brings your next Packmate back sooner.
Use Eviscerate when your Packmates are hurt. It heals them to full, and both of its hits shorten the Packmate cooldown.
Press The Call of the Pack just before a fight. You can't be targeted for a moment, and you gain damage, speed and extra Packmates.
Use Hounds' Pursuit on a champion who is running away. If you get the kill, recast it right away for a shield and a second dash.
Don't dash with Hounds' Pursuit when you are likely to be stunned during its short windup. Being interrupted cancels it.
Throw Darkin Daggers at the enemy champion, then recast once they bleed for extra damage and a heal. The lower their health, the harder it hits.
Use Darkin Daggers on low-health minions. The bleed finishes them off, which helps you last-hit and push the wave.
Hit champions with your abilities as often as you can. Each hit brings your next Packmate back sooner.
Use Eviscerate to dash onto the enemy and then back out. It hits twice, and the second hit is a burst around you.
Press The Call of the Pack to dodge a spell aimed at you, since you can't be targeted for a moment. It also adds Packmates, damage and speed.
At level 6, use Hounds' Pursuit to jump onto a squishy enemy champion. If you kill them, recast it for a shield and a second hit.
Hounds' Pursuit takes a moment to wind up, and stuns or knock-ups during it cancel it. Cast it when the enemy has no control spell ready.
Dodge the Aatrox swings by walking out of the telegraphed area. Use Eviscerate to dash clear, or The Call of the Pack to become untargetable.
When Aatrox's Infernal Chains hit you, move to the side or toward him to leave the circle. Standing still gets you pulled back and hit again.
Throw Darkin Daggers from long range to poke Aatrox. Recast it when he is low to deal extra damage and heal yourself.
Stay away from Aatrox while World Ender is active, since he heals more and a kill extends it. Hounds' Pursuit can finish a weakened Aatrox.
Keep Darkin Daggers on Briar from long range. Recast it once she is bleeding for extra damage and a heal.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable just as Head Rush or Chilling Scream would land on you.
Stay away from walls when Briar charges Chilling Scream, or the knockback will stun you and hurt a lot.
Hit her with Eviscerate, then use Hounds' Pursuit to finish her when she is low. A kill lets you recast it.
Stay out of Darius' Apprehend range. If it hits, you are pulled in and slowed.
Trade with Darkin Daggers from long range, and recast it for the heal when the bleed is on him. Do not walk into his axe.
Use Eviscerate to get away after a trade, or to hit him and leave before he can use Decimate.
Do not stay in a long fight with Darius. His Hemorrhage stacks build up, and at full stacks he hits much harder.
Keep your health up at level 6, because Noxian Guillotine deals true damage that grows with Hemorrhage stacks.
Do not throw Darkin Daggers or Eviscerate into a ready Fiora; Riposte blocks it and slows you.
Bait Riposte first, then dash in with Hounds' Pursuit once it is on cooldown.
Recast Darkin Daggers on Fiora once she is hurt; it heals you and hits harder the lower she is.
Watch the Vital on you and move so Fiora's Lunge has to dash into awkward spots.
Stay out of keg blast zones. Pop them yourself only if you can safely walk up; enemy attacks on a keg only defuse it.
Dodge the slow of Powder Keg; a slowed Naafiri is easy for Gangplank to hit with Parrrley.
Hit Gangplank with Darkin Daggers, then recast it when he is bleeding to deal more damage and heal.
Hounds' Pursuit won't stick if he cleanses with Remove Scurvy. Wait until it is on cooldown before diving him.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable and dodge a Parrrley or keg explosion aimed at you.
Hit Garen with Darkin Daggers from long range, then back off. He has no way to close the gap except Decisive Strike's speed boost.
Use The Call of the Pack to avoid Demacian Justice or his burst when you are low, since it makes you untargetable briefly.
Do not stand in Judgment with your packmates. Fight from the edge of its range and leave once it ends.
Hit him often to keep his Perseverance from healing him. Poke him with Darkin Daggers so he cannot regenerate.
Leave with Eviscerate after trading, before Garen's silence and spin catch you.
Close the gap with Eviscerate when Jayce is in Cannon form; he is weaker up close.
Dodge Jayce's Shock Blast; it stops at the first enemy it hits, so Packmates in front can soak it.
Land Darkin Daggers and recast it once he is hurt; the heal helps you win a trade.
Watch for Jayce dropping an Acceleration Gate; a stronger Shock Blast is coming.
Use The Call of the Pack to avoid his burst when he leaps in with To the Skies!.
Hit Darkin Daggers on K'Sante, then recast it once he is low to finish the bleed and heal yourself.
Stay out of Ntofo Strikes range when he has two stacks. The next cast stuns and pulls you in.
Wait for K'Sante to go All Out before you commit with Hounds' Pursuit. He loses health and resistances then.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Path Maker is about to land. It also gives you extra Packmates.
Throw Darkin Daggers at Malphite, then recast it once the bleed is on him to deal extra damage and heal.
Stay back from Ground Slam; it cuts your attack speed and your Packmates' too, so trade right after he uses it.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Malphite's Unstoppable Force when he dashes at you.
Do not trade into his shield; poke him down while Granite Shield is gone, since it refills when he is not hit.
Dodge Death's Grasp by sidestepping, or by going untargetable with The Call of the Pack; a pulled Naafiri takes heavy damage.
Do not stand in Mordekaiser's aura after he lands three hits; poke with Darkin Daggers from range instead.
Hit Mordekaiser with Eviscerate and Darkin Daggers together; that shreds his Indestructible shield before he can heal from it.
Realm of Death leaves you alone with him, so avoid being caught at level 6 and keep Hounds' Pursuit up to escape or fight back.
Stay out of Rumble's Flamespitter cone. Its damage grows with your max Health, so don't stand in it for long.
Dodge Electro Harpoon when you can; it is a straight shot that slows you and lowers your Magic Resist for the trade.
Go in with Hounds' Pursuit when Rumble Overheats; he cannot cast spells or shield himself then.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable and dodge his harpoon or The Equalizer when he commits them.
Use Eviscerate to jump out of The Equalizer's burning trail rather than walking through it.
Stay out of a long Decimating Smash charge. Sidestep it, or dash away with Eviscerate when the charge glows.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Sion commits a big spell, then hit back while he is on cooldown.
Poke with Darkin Daggers and recast it when he is bleeding to heal back damage. Do not stand in his Roar of the Slayer.
Do not trade into his Soul Furnace shield. Wait for it to break or fade, then go in.
When Sion dies, back away from the zombie form instead of chasing. Use that time to reset.
Dodge Blinding Dart if you can; being blinded ruins your attacks, so don't walk into a trade while you're hit by it.
Don't run through brush or unseen ground without caution; Noxious Trap mushrooms are hidden and slow you.
Hit Teemo with Darkin Daggers from range, then recast it when the bleed is on him to heal and deal more damage.
Use Eviscerate to dash in and out; it also heals your Packmates fully.
Save Hounds' Pursuit for level 6 to catch Teemo; it also lets you recast it if you score a takedown.
Stay away from walls near Vayne. Condemn into terrain stuns you and hurts a lot.
Wait until Vayne has used Condemn, then go in with Eviscerate or Hounds' Pursuit. She is fragile with it on cooldown.
Hit Vayne with Darkin Daggers, then recast for extra damage and healing while she is low.
Don't trade with Vayne for long. Silver Bolts hits hard on the third attack, so break off before then.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Condemn; you can't be targeted for a moment.
Hit Yone with Darkin Daggers, then recast it once he is bleeding. It deals big damage when he is low and heals you.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Yone's knock up and big trades. You are untargetable briefly and your pack grows.
Use Eviscerate to dash through Yone and burst him. It also heals your packmates back up after a fight.
Wait until Yone is low or his shield is gone, then finish him with Hounds' Pursuit. Recast it if you score a takedown.
Aatrox's swings are telegraphed. Step out of the Darkin Blade's area, and move to the side to escape Infernal Chains.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Aatrox's big ability, since you cannot be targeted at the start.
Use Darkin Daggers when he is low, then recast it to hit hard and heal. It works best on a bleeding target.
Use Hounds' Pursuit to dive Aatrox after his abilities are spent. He cannot escape easily because the dash slows him.
Stay away from Aatrox when he uses World Ender, so he cannot snowball from a kill.
Hit Ambessa with Darkin Daggers, then recast it when she is low to finish her and heal.
Wait for Ambessa to waste Repudiation before you dive in; it shields her and hits harder if you hit her during the brace.
Use Eviscerate to get out of range when Ambessa's Lacerate slows you, and to reset your packmates.
Stay away from Ambessa after level 6; Public Execution can reach you from long range and pins you down.
Stay out of Amumu's line and range for Bandage Toss; once you are stunned, his ultimate usually follows.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Amumu throws Bandage Toss at you.
Do not stand in Despair's range for long; it hurts more against high-Health targets, and your packmates take it too.
Stay spread out from your team near Amumu when his ultimate is ready.
Do not rely on physical damage alone against Amumu; Tantrum reduces it, so pick fights when it is on cooldown.
Hold Hounds' Pursuit for when Bel'Veth is low or has used her dashes; she is hard to catch while Void Surge is ready.
Dodge Above and Below, as it knocks you up and slows you. Wait for her to cast it before you go in.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable as Bel'Veth's big spells land, then hit back with extra packmates.
Back away from Royal Maelstrom; she takes less damage and heals while it spins. Fight her after it ends.
Dodge Sear, because it stuns you only if you are already ablaze. Without it his combo does not get going.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Brand's Pyroclasm is coming at you.
Step out of Pillar of Flame's circle after he casts it. It lands after a short delay.
Stay away from your packmates when Brand fights; his Conflagration spreads through them to you.
Jump on Brand with Hounds' Pursuit once his Sear is on cooldown. He is fragile and you can kill him.
Dodge Briar's Head Rush by keeping minions or distance between you; if it lands you are stunned and your resistances drop.
Stay away from walls when Briar charges Chilling Scream; a full charge knocks you into them for heavy damage and a stun.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Briar's burst; you are untargetable for a moment, so her leap and attacks miss.
Hit Briar with Darkin Daggers from range when she has no Blood Frenzy running, then recast for the bigger hit and a heal.
Stay out of Apprehend's cone. If it hits, Darius pulls you in and slows you, and you cannot dash away while you are knocked up.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Darius's big hit. You cannot be targeted for a moment, and the extra Packmates and speed help you leave or fight.
Throw Darkin Daggers from long range and recast it to heal. Darius has to walk into your range to answer.
Do not stay in melee range for a long fight. Hit him, then leave with Eviscerate before his Hemorrhage stacks build up.
Once Darius is low, finish him with Hounds' Pursuit. His escape tools are limited, so press your lead.
Hit Diana with Darkin Daggers, then recast it when she is low to deal extra damage and heal yourself.
Step out of Crescent Strike; if you are marked with Moonlight, Diana can dash onto you again quickly with Lunar Rush.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Moonfall's damage; you are untargetable while you prepare to hunt.
Fight Diana after her Pale Cascade shield and orbs run out; she is much easier to burst then.
Don't expect to stun or root Dr. Mundo; Goes Where He Pleases resists the first one, so make him spend it first.
Step out of the line of Infected Bonesaw; it slows you and heals him when it hits.
Hit Dr. Mundo with Darkin Daggers, then recast it for the finishing hit and your own healing.
Don't stay close while Heart Zapper charges. Leave or burst him before the recast, or he heals the damage back.
Hit him hard right after Maximum Dosage starts, or walk away. He heals through slow damage.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge his Blunt Force Trauma swing, since you can't be targeted at first.
Walk out of the Parallel Convergence zone once you see its marker. Staying inside gets you stunned.
Chronobreak makes Ekko hard to kill. Wait for it to be on cooldown, or trail him, before you dive in.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Ekko's burst. You are untargetable at the start, so time it as his abilities land.
Dodge the first Timewinder throw sideways. The return hit hurts more, so leave its field quickly.
Stay away from Evelynn when an Allure arrow points at you. Walk toward your packmates and keep your distance until the charm is gone.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Evelynn dives in. It also gives you extra damage and speed to fight back.
Ward your jungle entrances, because Evelynn can hide until she is close. Evelynn's Last Caress also hurts a lot when your health is low, so stay healthy.
Recast Darkin Daggers on Evelynn when she is bleeding to heal yourself in a fight.
Hunt Fiddlesticks with Hounds' Pursuit once he is caught out; it hits him fast and slows him briefly.
Watch for a lone scarecrow or still brush; Fiddlesticks may be waiting there, so ward before walking in.
Stay out of Reap's slow and silence; do not step into its center, or you cannot use your dash.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Crowstorm or Terrify at the last moment while untargetable.
Jump in with Eviscerate only when Graves has Quickdraw on cooldown; otherwise he becomes sturdy and dashes away.
Walk around the edge of Graves' End of the Line path, since it detonates again along the trail after a moment.
Leave Smoke Screen's cloud right away; the slow ends the moment you step out.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable and dodge Graves' burst, then go in with extra speed.
Commit with Hounds' Pursuit once Collateral Damage is on cooldown. Graves is easy to catch with no escape.
Hit Graves with Darkin Daggers and recast it once he is low; it heals you when it hits a champion.
Hit Gwen with Darkin Daggers, then recast it once she is low to heal and finish her.
Wait for Gwen to use Hallowed Mist before you commit Hounds' Pursuit. Her mist makes her untargetable to you while you are outside it.
Fight Gwen before she has attacked a few times; she needs hits to power up her damage. Jump her early.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Needlework and add packmates before a fight.
Wait for Hecarim to spend Devastating Charge, then fight him. Without it he has little to reach you with.
Do not stand next to his allies when you jump in with Hounds' Pursuit. Onslaught of Shadows can fear you right after.
Hit him with Darkin Daggers, then recast it when he is low. He heals from Spirit of Dread, so burst him fast.
Use Eviscerate to burst him when he has no Spirit of Dread; he lacks durability.
Stay clear of Rootcaller; a rooted Naafiri is an easy target for Ivern's team to jump on.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable and dodge Rootcaller as the vine arrives.
Hit Ivern with Hounds' Pursuit when he is alone; he is squishy, but check for Daisy! first.
Check brush before walking in; Ivern's Brushmaker can hide an ambush.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard, or you will be knocked up.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge his Cataclysm or Dragon Strike when you see it coming.
If you are trapped by Cataclysm, escape with Eviscerate; the dash can go through the terrain.
Hit him with Darkin Daggers, then recast it once he is hurt to heal and finish him.
Wait out Counter Strike before you attack Jax; your attacks get dodged and the stun follows.
Trade in short bursts with Darkin Daggers and Eviscerate, then back off. Long fights let Jax's Attack Speed climb.
Recast Darkin Daggers on a hurt Jax to heal and finish the bleed.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Jax's Leap Strike or burst, since you cannot be targeted for a moment.
Save Eviscerate to get out of Jayce's reach or to finish a trade; the dash and blades both hurt.
Hit Jayce with Darkin Daggers from range, then recast it when he is hurt to heal and deal more damage.
Do not dive in when Thundering Blow is ready; it roots you and knocks you back. Wait until he has used it.
Use Hounds' Pursuit at level 6 to catch Jayce when he is low; a kill lets you recast it.
Walk out of Wall of Pain rather than through it. Crossing it slows you and lowers your Magic Resist.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Lay Waste as it lands. You cannot be targeted for a moment.
Dive Karthus with Hounds' Pursuit, since he has no dash to escape. Kill him fast, because he can keep casting after he dies.
After a kill, step away from his corpse. His spirit form can still hit you with Defile.
Dodge Blade's Reach when Kayn swings it; if it misses, he cannot dive you from long range with Umbral Trespass.
Watch for the warning at the edge of a wall; Kayn is in Shadow Step there and may be coming for you.
Hit Kayn during Shadow Step with Darkin Daggers to cut its duration short and leave him out in the open.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Kayn commits to a dive, then fight back with your extra Packmates.
Stay near allied minions or teammates so Kha'Zix cannot treat you as isolated and hit you with a huge Taste Their Fear.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Kha'Zix's burst, since you cannot be targeted when it begins.
Punish Kha'Zix when Leap is on cooldown; he has little escape then. Chase with Hounds' Pursuit.
Watch for the brush and Void Assault; his next hit slows you, so stay near your Packmates.
Wait for Kindred to use Dance of Arrows, then dive in with Hounds' Pursuit; she has less escape for a while.
Do not chase Kindred into Wolf's Frenzy; Wolf bites you while she stays inside it.
Watch for Lamb's Respite; kill nobody inside it, and save your burst until it ends.
Hit Kindred with Darkin Daggers and recast it for the heal; it also keeps you sturdy against her poke.
Hit Lee Sin with Darkin Daggers, then recast it for extra damage and healing.
Press The Call of the Pack when Lee Sin is about to kick or strike you; you cannot be targeted for a moment.
Use Eviscerate to get out of Lee Sin's reach or to hit him with a burst of blades.
Fight Lee Sin when he is low on Energy; his ability chain falls apart after a few casts.
Dodge Swirlseed, which rolls on until it hits you or a wall. If you get slowed, hold off on diving in.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable just as the strike of Lillia's Watch Out! Eep!
Step out of the center of Lillia's Watch Out! Eep!
Chase Lillia with Hounds' Pursuit once she is hurt. Her Move Speed gets strong when she lands abilities, so catch her early.
Do not rely on Hounds' Pursuit to stop Master Yi once Highlander is on; he ignores the slow.
Hit Master Yi with Darkin Daggers and recast it when he is low; it deals extra damage and heals you.
Hit him a few times so he must spend mana on Meditate to heal.
Save Eviscerate to get away from Master Yi, or to hit him when he lands from Alpha Strike.
Wukong can leave a clone and vanish. Hit the real one with Darkin Daggers, and recast it when his Health is low to heal and finish him.
Don't dive in on top of Wukong when Cyclone is ready; it knocks you up. Wait for him to spend it first.
Short fights favor you. Use Eviscerate to strike and reset, since it heals your packmates to full, then back out before his Stone Skin stacks up.
Use The Call of the Pack to avoid his Nimbus Strike or burst, then fight back with your extra packmates and bonus damage.
Dodge Javelin Toss when Nidalee is far away; it hurts most from long range and marks you as Hunted.
Use Eviscerate to dash out of Nidalee's Pounce follow-up, since she must get close to use Takedown.
Use The Call of the Pack when Nidalee jumps at you; you are untargetable for a moment.
Hit Nidalee with Darkin Daggers and recast it when she is low; the extra damage grows as her health drops and you heal.
Use Hounds' Pursuit to reach Nidalee when she is hurt, since she is fragile.
Wait out Nocturne's Shroud of Darkness before you use Hounds' Pursuit or Darkin Daggers; it blocks them. Bait it first with a cheap ability.
Dodge Duskbringer by stepping aside; it is a narrow line.
Keep your Eviscerate for when Nocturne casts Unspeakable Horror; dash away to break the tether before the fear lands.
Don't fight Nocturne's Umbra Blades when it's ready; it heals him off you and your packmates.
Stay near allies when Nocturne casts Paranoia; his dash can land on you with no warning.
Poke Nunu with Darkin Daggers, then recast for the heal when he is already bleeding.
Sidestep Biggest Snowball Ever! with a sharp turn or Eviscerate; it turns slowly, and getting hit by a big one means a stun.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Nunu's snowball or barrage is about to hit you.
Don't stand in Absolute Zero for long; leave the blizzard early or dash out with Eviscerate before the slow grows.
Do not fight Pantheon head-on when he braces Aegis Assault; wait it out or hit him from another side.
Keep your health up around Pantheon; a thrown Comet Spear hits much harder on low health targets.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Shield Vault; being untargetable makes his jump miss you.
When Pantheon starts Grand Starfall, move away from the marked area; the warning lasts several seconds.
Use The Call of the Pack when Qiyana dashes in with Audacity. Her damage lands on nothing, and you come out with extra packmates.
Stay away from walls and brush when Qiyana's Supreme Display of Talent is ready. It stuns along terrain edges.
Hit Qiyana with Darkin Daggers, then recast when she is low. The bleed and the heal win you a short trade.
Use Hounds' Pursuit on Qiyana once she has spent Audacity. Without that dash she struggles to get out.
Don't dive Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is up; your physical damage does little and hitting him hurts you. Wait for it to end.
Stay out of Frenzying Taunt range, or hold The Call of the Pack to become untargetable as he casts it.
Hit him with Darkin Daggers from range and recast it to heal, but watch for his Powerball roll closing in.
Use Eviscerate to dash away when Powerball is coming at you; it is faster than walking.
Use Hounds' Pursuit to dive Rek'Sai when she is away from her tunnels; her packmates dash alongside you.
Watch for Void Rush after you have hurt Rek'Sai's target: she vanishes briefly, then lands on you. Use The Call of the Pack as it lands to dodge it.
Stay unmoving in the brush when Rek'Sai is near; she can only see you while you are moving.
Use Darkin Daggers on Rek'Sai, then recast it once she is hurt to heal and deal more damage.
Stay out of Furious Bite range when her Fury is full, as it then hits hard.
Stay out of brush when Rengar is near. His Unseen Predator makes him leap onto you from far away.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Rengar leaps at you, so his burst hits nothing.
Fight Rengar while his Ferocity is low. At full Ferocity his Bola Strike roots you.
Hit him with Darkin Daggers from range, then recast it when he is low to deal damage and heal.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable right as Sejuani throws Glacial Prison or Arctic Assault at you.
Sejuani stops being slowed once she has Frost Armor, so do not rely on Hounds' Pursuit to hold her in place.
Sejuani is tanky, so aim Hounds' Pursuit at her squishy teammates instead, and stay clear of the stun that Permafrost can give her.
Use Eviscerate to dash away after Sejuani's second swing of Winter's Wrath starts; that swing carries most of the damage.
Don't chase Shaco into brush or unwarded paths; Jack In The Box can fear and root you there.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Shaco jumps in, and Eviscerate to get away after Deceive.
Hit Shaco with Darkin Daggers and recast it when he is low; it deals more damage and heals you.
Don't chase the Hallucinate clone; when it dies it explodes and spawns boxes. Hit the real Shaco instead.
Stay out of long fights with Shyvana. Hit her with Darkin Daggers, then Recast it to finish the bleed and heal yourself.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Shyvana's burst; you become untargetable for a moment and gain speed to chase or run.
Eviscerate away from Shyvana once she has used Molten Burst, and avoid clustering your packmates in its path.
Use Hounds' Pursuit to pick off Shyvana when she is low on Dragon Fury, before she can transform.
Do not fight Skarner near walls; if Ixtal's Impact grabs you, hitting terrain stuns you. Keep Eviscerate ready to escape.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Skarner commits Impale or his charge.
Skarner's Quaking builds with attacks, so poke him and back out rather than trading toe to toe.
Recast Darkin Daggers on Skarner to heal and hit him harder when he is low.
Wait for Sylas to spend Abscond / Abduct before you commit; without it he has a hard time catching you.
Stay out of Sylas's reach when he is hurt and avoid long fights; Kingslayer heals him when he hits you.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge his key spells; it makes you untargetable at the start, and Kingslayer can't hit you then.
Fight Sylas when he has no ultimate to steal; Hounds' Pursuit is a strong one for him to take, so use it when he can't hijack it.
Recast Darkin Daggers once he is bleeding to deal big damage and heal back what Chain Lash took.
Do not trade when Talon has Shadow Assault ready; he can vanish and turn the fight. Bait it out first.
Use The Call of the Pack when Talon jumps on you. It makes you untargetable for a moment and wastes his burst.
Recast Darkin Daggers on a bleeding Talon when he is low. It deals big damage and heals you.
Step out of Rake's path; its blades come back and leave you slowed.
Hounds' Pursuit chases Talon down after he uses Shadow Assault or after a fight, so use it once his escape is gone.
Avoid fighting Trundle on his Frozen Domain; he is much faster and hits harder there. Pull the fight away from it.
Leave Pillar of Ice quickly if he casts it on you; it slows you and walls your dash path.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge his Subjugate or Chomp; you are untargetable for a moment.
Hit him with Darkin Daggers and recast when he is low; you heal and deal extra damage to a hurt target.
Don't feed kills near him; his King's Tribute heals him when enemies die close by.
Hit Udyr with Darkin Daggers from range and recast it when he is bleeding for extra damage and healing. He has few ranged tools.
Do not let Udyr reach you with a Blazing Stampede attack; he stuns you. Keep your distance, and use Eviscerate to get away.
Wait until Udyr has spent his Iron Mantle shield before you commit with Hounds' Pursuit.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge his burst; you are briefly untargetable and gain extra packmates.
Do not stay inside Wingborne Storm; it slows you and hurts your packmates.
Dodge a charging Vault Breaker by stepping aside or using Eviscerate. A full charge hurts a lot.
Use The Call of the Pack just before Vi's Cease and Desist lands. Being untargetable can make her ult fail.
Do not trade for long with Vi. Three hits in a row cut your Armor and speed up her attacks.
Hit Vi with Darkin Daggers, then recast it once she is low. It deals more damage and heals you.
Stay away from Vi once she is level 6. If she dashes at you with Cease and Desist, you cannot escape it with Eviscerate.
Dodge Spectral Maw's blast; it hits only the first enemy, so keep a packmate or minion between you and Viego to absorb it.
Recast Darkin Daggers on a bleeding Viego for extra damage and a heal; use it when he is hurt.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable and dodge his stun or Heartbreaker, then hit him with extra packmates.
Do not die near Viego with a wraith; he can possess you and use your abilities against you.
Watch for mist walls from Harrowed Path; Viego may be hiding inside, so don't walk in blind.
Hit Volibear with Darkin Daggers, then recast it once he is hurt. It deals more damage to low Health targets and heals you.
Do not fight Volibear head-on when he has Thundering Smash ready. If he reaches you, the stun lets him win the trade.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge his Thundering Smash or Sky Splitter. You cannot be targeted for a short time, and you then hit harder and run faster.
Dash away with Eviscerate when Volibear lands Stormbringer. He is tankier and slows nearby enemies, so do not stay close.
Do not trust Warwick to stay hurt and flee; he senses weak champions and chases them down with Blood Hunt.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Warwick commits with Infinite Duress or Jaws of the Beast.
Land Darkin Daggers early and recast it when Warwick is low; it heals you and the bleed wears him down.
Do not fight him when he is low on health; Eternal Hunger heals him a lot. Burst him down quickly, or back off.
Use Eviscerate to get out of range once Warwick Fears you after Primal Howl.
Hit Xin Zhao with Darkin Daggers early and recast it once he is bleeding; you heal and deal more damage the lower his health is.
Stay away from Xin Zhao when his Three Talon Strike is ready; the third hit knocks you up and he follows up.
Use Eviscerate to dash away once Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge is used, since he has no other gap closer.
Do not stand clumped with your allies in a fight; Crescent Guard knocks back everyone it hits.
Stay out of Zac's reach when he starts charging Elastic Slingshot. If it lands, you are knocked up and stunned.
Use Eviscerate to dash away when you are knocked up. It will not help while you are still in the air.
Step on Zac's goo chunks in a fight; it destroys them and denies his healing.
Kill his bloblets when he splits apart, or he comes back. Your packmates and Darkin Daggers can help finish them.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Zac's Stretching Strikes or Elastic Slingshot is about to land.
Hold Eviscerate to escape or to finish Zed after he spends his Living Shadow; it is a quick dash that also deals damage.
Use The Call of the Pack when Zed casts Death Mark on you or dives in; you are untargetable for a short time at the start.
Keep Darkin Daggers for when Zed is low, and recast it to finish him and heal.
Stay away from Zed's shadow when he uses Shadow Slash; the shadow's slash is what slows you.
Don't run in a straight line toward Zyra. Grasping Roots will root you, so wait for it to be used before you dive.
Step on her seeds before she can grow them. Be ready to dodge back when she tries to grow one as you step on it.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Zyra casts Grasping Roots. You dodge the root and gain speed to close in.
Dive Zyra with Hounds' Pursuit when she has used her roots. She is fragile, and a takedown lets you recast it.
Fight away from her plants. They are short-lived, so Eviscerate out when she grows a group of them.
Stay out of Charm's line behind minions, and sidestep it; it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable and dodge Charm when you see Ahri cast it.
Go in with Hounds' Pursuit when Spirit Rush is on cooldown; Ahri has much less escape then.
Hit Ahri with Darkin Daggers, then recast for extra damage and healing when she is low.
Use Eviscerate to close in and burst Ahri once her Charm is used.
Hit Akali with Darkin Daggers, then recast it when she is hurt. The recast heals you if it hits a champion.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Akali's burst; you can't be targeted for a moment.
Engage Akali when her Energy is low; her Five Point Strike is weak then.
Chase Akali down with Hounds' Pursuit when she is low on Health. A kill lets you recast it.
Throw area attacks like Eviscerate into Akali's smoke; they still hit her and briefly show where she is.
Sidestep Flash Frost; it is wide and slow-moving, and the stun comes when it ends or is recast. Stay out of its path as it travels.
Wait for Anivia to use Flash Frost, then go in with Hounds' Pursuit or Eviscerate while it is on cooldown.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable and dodge Frostbite or Flash Frost, then close in with the extra speed.
Do not fight inside Glacial Storm; it slows you and hurts more once fully formed. Go around it or hit Anivia from outside.
When Anivia becomes an egg, back off or finish it quickly. Your Packmates and Darkin Daggers help.
Hit Aurora with Darkin Daggers, then recast it for extra damage and a heal. Her low health makes the recast hit harder.
Wait until Aurora has used Across the Veil before you commit to a dive. Without it, she has fewer ways to escape.
Do not dash in straight lines into The Weirding; the slow lets her kite you away.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge her spell and gain extra packmates before you go in.
Hounds' Pursuit reveals Aurora and reaches her even after she vanishes, so use it to finish her.
Bait out Miasma before you commit with Eviscerate. Being grounded stops your dash.
Turn away from Cassiopeia as she casts Petrifying Gaze. You get slowed instead of stunned.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge Cassiopeia's key spell. You can't be targeted for a moment, and the extra Move Speed helps you close in.
Sidestep Noxious Blast, because it lands after a short delay. Then close the gap while Cassiopeia's Move Speed bonus has run out.
Throw Darkin Daggers at her. Recast when she is low, as it deals more damage and heals you.
Hold Hounds' Pursuit until Fizz has used Playful; if he still has it, he can dodge your dash.
Hit Fizz with Darkin Daggers and recast it once he is hurt; it heals you when it hits a champion.
Stay out of his reach when Urchin Strike is ready; he can dash onto you and burst you.
Sidestep Chum the Waters when you see the fish thrown; a hit slows you and the shark then knocks you up.
Jump on Malzahar with Hounds' Pursuit when his Void Shift is down. It's your best way to burst him, so hit him once he has been damaged.
Stay out of Call of the Void's area. Being silenced leaves you unable to use Eviscerate or Darkin Daggers to get away or to fight.
Save The Call of the Pack for when Malzahar uses his silence. Being untargetable also helps you avoid Nether Grasp.
Don't stand in Malefic Visions' spread range. Avoid minion waves it has marked, since the visions jump to you when they die.
Stay out of Orianna's Ball range and hit her with Darkin Daggers; a bleeding target takes more damage if you recast it.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable and dodge Orianna's burst, then fight with bonus damage and speed.
Wait until Orianna has spent Command: Shockwave before diving; it stuns and pulls you toward the Ball.
Use Eviscerate to dash out of Orianna's Ball range or to dodge Command: Attack, which has a delay.
Stay out of Ryze's Flux. Once he has marked you, Rune Prison roots you and Overload hits much harder.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge his burst. You are untargetable for the first moment, so his targeted spells cannot hit you.
Look for Hounds' Pursuit once he has spent Rune Prison. Without it he has little to stop you, and a kill lets you recast.
Aim Darkin Daggers at Ryze, then recast to heal and deal more damage. Land it when he is low.
Throw Darkin Daggers at Sylas, then recast it when the bleed is on him; it hurts more the lower his health is and heals you.
Stay out of Chain Lash range and sidestep it; being slowed lets Sylas catch you with the follow-up.
Keep your distance from Abduct; its chains stop at the first enemy hit, so your packmates can block it.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Sylas goes for Kingslayer; it cannot hit you then.
Fight Sylas when his Hijack is on cooldown for you; if he steals Hounds' Pursuit he can't do it again for a while.
Watch for Twisted Fate shuffling his deck above his head; a Gold Card stun is coming, so stay out of his attack range or wait it out.
Sidestep Wild Cards before you dash in; the cone is wide, so move out of the angle rather than straight back.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable when Twisted Fate is about to land a card, then close in with extra speed.
When Twisted Fate uses Destiny to teleport, expect him to appear near you; he is squishy, so punish him with Hounds' Pursuit.
Hit him with Darkin Daggers, then recast for the bigger hit once he is lower on health; it also heals you.
Do not stand in Gravity Field. Step out before it finishes charging, or you will be stunned.
Save Eviscerate to dodge a Hextech Ray or leave a field, and use it to jump in when his abilities are down.
Use The Call of the Pack to become untargetable and avoid his Siphon Power or Gravity Field while you close in.
Hit him with Darkin Daggers, then recast it to finish the bleed and heal when he is low.
Go for Hounds' Pursuit once his shield and Gravity Field are spent. Viktor is fragile and cannot easily escape you.
Hit Yasuo with Darkin Daggers when he has no minion in front. Recast it once he is bleeding to hit hard and heal.
Don't throw Darkin Daggers into Wind Wall; wait for it to fade, because it blocks projectiles.
Stay away from Yasuo once he has two Steel Tempest stacks; his whirlwind knocks you up and sets up Last Breath.
Use Eviscerate to jump in right after Yasuo has fired his whirlwind, when he is weakest.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge his whirlwind, since you are untargetable for a moment.
Land Darkin Daggers on Yone, then recast it once he is hurt; it deals more damage and heals you.
Stay out of Mortal Steel range when he has two stacks; the third cast dashes in and knocks you up.
Use The Call of the Pack to dodge his big combo; you are untargetable at the start, and it gives you extra packmates.
Don't chase him in spirit form with Soul Unbound; he snaps back to his body and takes the trade with him.
Save Hounds' Pursuit to finish him after he spends his abilities, and recast it if you get the kill.
Dodge Razor Shuriken by stepping sideways. Zed's Shadow throws a second one from another angle, so watch for both.
Zed is weakest right after he casts Living Shadow, because his slow and extra damage depend on it. Jump on him then with Eviscerate.
Use The Call of the Pack when Zed casts Death Mark on you; it makes you untargetable and speeds you up. Fight back with your Packmates around you.
Use Darkin Daggers on Zed when he is low, then recast it to finish him and heal.
Zed gets slowed only by his Shadow's slash, so stay out of the Shadow's range of you.
